title: Potassium & the ECG

findings.title: Text alternative calls the schematic strip the client's
findings.problem: The description ends with "The hyperkalemia strip is outlined as this client's" (and similarly for hypokalemia). The input supplies only k, not an ECG. This wording implies patient-specific ECG findings despite the diagram's explicit warning that potassium cannot predict them reliably.
findings.fix: Replace it with "The outline identifies the client's potassium category; the strip shows possible findings, not this client's recorded ECG."

assessment: Correct the worked-step text alternative: it attributes an illustrative ECG pattern to a client whose only supplied measurement is potassium.
